claims.claim_text: As of December 31, 2023, Viking operated a fleet of 92 ships, including 81 river vessels, nine ocean ships, and two expedition ships, itemized by individual named vessel.
claims.subject: Viking Holdings Ltd
claims.source_quote: As of December 31, 2023, we had a fleet of 92 ships, including: (1) 81 river vessels ... (2) nine ocean ships; and (3) two expedition ships.

claims.claim_text: Viking has the largest contracted newbuild orderbook in the cruise industry, with 18 river vessels ordered for delivery by 2026 and six new ocean ships on order for delivery through 2028, plus options for additional ships.
claims.subject: Viking newbuilding program
claims.object_value: 18 river + 6 ocean newbuilds; largest in industry
claims.source_quote: we plan to continue expanding our fleet, with the most contracted future ship deliveries in the industry ... our contracted capacity represents approximately 42% of this new comparable supply

claims.claim_text: Viking has secured shipyard newbuild financing: SACE Financing for up to 80% of ocean-ship contract prices, and Hermes-guaranteed loans (95% guarantees) for the eight Longships and two Longships-Seine river vessels.
claims.subject: Viking newbuild financing
claims.source_quote: These loans are SACE Financing and are for up to 80% of each newbuild's contract price ... Hermes has provided guarantees equal to 95% of the loan amounts.

claims.claim_text: As of December 31, 2023 Viking held $3,486.6 million of deferred revenue, reflecting significant advance customer bookings (its booking curve) collected well ahead of cruise dates.
claims.subject: Viking deferred revenue / advance bookings
claims.source_quote: a working capital deficit of $2,011.3 million. The working capital deficit included $3,486.6 million of deferred revenue.

claims.claim_text: Viking's consolidated financial statements were audited by Ernst & Young AS (PCAOB ID 1572), which has served as the Company's auditor since 2010, with an unqualified opinion.
claims.subject: Ernst & Young AS
claims.source_quote: Report of Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm Ernst & Young AS (PCAOB ID: 1572) ... We have served as the Company's auditor since 2010.

claims.claim_text: Viking employs over 9,500 crewmembers from over 90 countries at the peak of the 2023 season, with a crew retention rate of about 80%.
claims.subject: Viking crew
claims.source_quote: Our crew, with over 9,500 crewmembers from over 90 different countries at the peak of the 2023 season ... our crew retention rate of about 80% as of December 31, 2023.

claims.claim_text: Viking entered an accommodation purchase agreement (Feb 2024) for all cabins on select sailings of the Zhao Shang Yi Dun, owned and operated by CMV (the China JV Investment), traveling in China for 72 days in Q3/Q4 2024.
claims.subject: Zhao Shang Yi Dun / CMV China JV
claims.source_quote: In February 2024, the Group entered into an accommodation purchase agreement for all cabins on select sailings on the Zhao Shang Yi Dun, which is owned and operated by CMV, traveling in China for 72 days in the third and fourth quarters of 2024.
